618-2240-2943.easyPrerequisites: Conspicuous Snoop does not have summoning sickness.
618-2240-2943.description:
Cast Goblin Recruiter by paying {1}{R}. When it enters, it triggers, searching your library for Kiki-Jiki and putting it on top of your library.
Activate Conspicuous Snoop using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of Conspicuous Snoop with haste.
Repeat step 2 using the Conspicuous Snoop token.

2226-2499-6408.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-6408.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Storm Sculptor by paying its mana cost.
When Storm Sculptor enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

883-5170-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

4742-4770-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-4644-5724.easyPrerequisites: Sage of the Maze and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-4644-5724.description:
Activate Sage of the Maze by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Sage of the Maze, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-6255--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-6255--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

645-1267-2719-3899.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2719-3899.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
Repeat each turn.

1981-2415-5231-5870.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5231-5870.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

413-4094-4559-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
413-4094-4559-7839.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-4565-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire
Repeat.

1020-1117-6518-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1020-1117-6518-7693.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-222-413-527.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-413-527.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3698-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
3698-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
When the Mutagens enter, Grinding Station triggers that many times, untapping Grinding Station
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 3.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4475-7276.manaNeeded: {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable if Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield
4475-7276.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Dark Leo & Shredder if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
Dark Leo & Shredder doesn't have summoning sickness if it's on the battlefield.
You control at least four Ninjas.
4475-7276.description:
Declare Dark Leo & Shredder as an attacker if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
If Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield, when the declared creature is unblocked, cast Dark Leo & Shredder either from your hand or from the command zone for its sneak cost by paying {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable and returning the unblocked attacker to your hand.
Deal combat damage using Dark Leo & Shredder, triggering its second ability, creating a 1/1 Ninja creature token and causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing the opponent to lose the rest of their life total.
4475-7276.notes: You must control four Ninjas when Dark Leo & Shredder deals combat damage. Notably, if it isn't on the battlefield, you must control five total Ninjas if the attacker you will be returning is a Ninja.

343-969-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-969-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2760-3108-5400.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Synth Infiltrator.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Synth Infiltrator by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

339-677-3480-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2835-3490-4050-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2835-3490-4050-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3301-3525-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3301-3525-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3301-3525-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

4067-6764.description:
Activate Insight Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, putting a charge counter on Insight Engine and then drawing a card for each charge counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Insight Engine.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-3259-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-3259-6633.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1912-2060-3334-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-3334-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

804-1617-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
804-1617-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Sakashima the Impostor to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

2770-4691-5919.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

277-5414-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
277-5414-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

1283-1651-2645-4824.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Soliton, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Soliton by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities and/or untap any artifact(s) you control.

290-1978-3789.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat from step 2.

364-614-1283-1987.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
